# Pass One — Unbounded Brainstorm

Awtsmoos makes the moment new; the interface may reveal that truth anew.

- Unified app + game marketplace with search, categories, featured collections, recents, trending and launch-ready cards.
- Wallet balance chip in shared shells, quick top-up, ledger access and clear Peruta denomination.
- Product credit packs backed by explicit Peruta exchange rules and server-authoritative ownership.
- Reusable purchase sheet: what is bought, price, balance before/after, receipt, insufficient-balance path.
- Transparent free starter allowances; purchased credits must not silently expire.
- App offers: compute/render/export/storage/batch/collaboration capacity rather than locking basic usefulness.
- Game offers: cosmetics, themes, challenge/level packs and non-pay-to-win convenience; no wagering mechanics.
- Product detail pages with screenshots, use cases, credit model, privacy, accessibility and device support.
- Cross-promotion based on relevant workflows, not intrusive ads.
- Referral/loyalty/reward systems with abuse caps and transparent rules.
- Funnel analytics: impression → launch → activation → quote → purchase → successful spend → return.
- Mobile safe areas, 44px touch targets, responsive typography, reduced motion, visible focus, offline/failure states.
- PWA/install prompts, optimized assets, share metadata, localization and RTL readiness.
